turns.prompt:
You are given two attached CSV files:
  - nlo_shg_train.csv: 200 crystalline materials, columns `formula`,
    `poscar` (the crystal structure, in POSCAR format) and `shg` (the
    largest SHG tensor component |d_ij|, in pm/V).
  - nlo_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE crystalline materials whose properties are
    NOT given, columns `candidate_id`, `formula` and `poscar` (the crystal
    structure, in POSCAR format).

Using the training data, predict which candidates have the LARGEST SHG
tensor component |d_ij| (pm/V), then select the 5 best candidates from the
pool.

Reason from the structures, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
# Reasoning from structures

## Key patterns in training data

Looking at the highest SHG values in the training set:
- **Ternary tellurides / chalcopyrite-type Te compounds**: very high (Li2 In4 Cu2 Te8 = 74, Zn2 Ga4 Te8 = 92, Cd2 Ga4 Te8 = 92, Ga4 Hg2 Se8 = 73)
- **Non-centrosymmetric ordered chalcopyrite/adamantine structures** (tetragonal, Ga/Al + Cu/Ag + Se) score high: Ga2Cu2GeSe8 = 54, Ga2Ag2SnSe8 = 54, In2Ag2SnSe8 = 60, Al2CuSnSe8 = 49
- **Se-based adamantine networks** generally 40-70 pm/V
- **Sulfides/S-based** are lower (~10-30), **oxides/halides/chlorides** very low (<5)
- The **Mg-Ga-Se / Li-Mg-Ga-Se / Li-Zn-Ga-Se** family clusters around 15-30, with some polymorphs reaching 30-60 (Mg1Ga2Se4 = 62, Li2Zn2Ga2Se6 = 31).

## Assessing the pool

The pool is dominated by Ga-Se compounds (Mg-Ga-Se, Li-Zn-Ga-Se, Li-Mg-Ga-Se). Based on training, these tend to give moderate-to-high values (~15-60). Key discriminators favoring high SHG:
- **Se over S**, **tetrahedral adamantine networks**, **non-centrosymmetric polar arrangements**.

Strong candidates:
- **c093 (Al4 Cu4 Se8)** — this is a chalcopyrite AlCuSe2-type adamantine Se structure, closely matching high-scoring Ga/Al-Cu-Se chalcopyrites (~49-54). Very promising.
- **c056 (In2 Ag2 Ge2 Se8)** — matches In2Ag2SnSe8 (=60) and Ga2Ag2SnSe8 (=54) closely. High.
- **c071 (Al2 Cu2 Ge2 Se8)** — matches Ga2Cu2GeSe8 (=54), Al2CuSnSe8 (=49). High.
- **c082 (Al4 Hg2 Se8)** — analog of Ga4Hg2Se8 (=73), a very high scorer. Very promising.
- **c073 (Cd In3 Te4 As)** — a Te-based adamantine/tetrahedral compound; Te compounds score very high (74-92).

The many Mg-Ga-Se / Li-Zn-Ga-Se polymorphs are more moderate (15-30 typical), so I rank the Se-chalcopyrite and Te candidates above them.

## Final ranking

c082 (Hg-Se adamantine, analog of 73 pm/V), c073 (Te adamantine, Te→very high), c056 (In-Ag-Ge-Se, analog of 60), c071 (Al-Cu-Ge-Se, analog of 54), c093 (Al-Cu-Se chalcopyrite, analog of 49-54).

Final: c082, c073, c056, c071, c093
